scope: Independent read-only source, saved-receipt and primary-literature review. No new atmosphere calculation or timing-eigenmode inference.
reviewed_claims: The base radiation.rates object precedes receiving PI/RR and charge-exchange additions in solar.py. Its inverse gross rates are explicitly labelled incomplete one-way scales, not full coupled relaxation times.

Thermal scale is base hydrogen heating plus cooling and the sum of absolute thermal-ledger net terms. 3P/(2*thermal_scale) is a diagnostic turnover quantity, not total cooling, a linear relaxation eigenvalue, or latent chemical energy.

The 2183.16-second selected data interval and 6.146-degree viewing change do not establish an event lifetime. The 1.07067-percent illumination endpoint change follows the explicitly assumed twice-orbit sinusoid, not a recovered stellar irradiation history.

Ahlers et al. IV.2 supports wavelength-dependent twice-orbit irradiation, about 10 percent UV and 1–2 percent visible. Leenaarts et al. abstract supports H-alpha CRD only under its stated solar history/Lyman-profile assumptions. Lowson et al. abstract explicitly retains stellar alternatives to a high-excited-hydrogen tail. The report preserves these applicability limits.

The corrected conditional H-alpha/Ly-beta/O I comparison is now described as a 0.0534-percentage-point outer H-alpha survival change. Other-shell and ionization exits are not identified with permanent complete-atmosphere photon loss.
The radial-profile comparison is presented as a structural clue requiring matched observer geometry; the proposed source/column swap is a future discriminator, not an executed causal isolation.
limitations: This review did not independently recompute the new free-model radial-column table or a full time-dependent equilibrium. Its numeric provenance must be pinned by the owning report/evidence.

The report hash identifies the text reviewed at this point; later editorial/numerical report updates require the root final document pin. No physical origin of the weak phase-local residual is established.
outcome: No material inconsistency found in the reviewed scope after correcting the conditional photon-survival wording.
